AddTenantAdministratorRequest.description:
Body of `POST /platform/tenants/{id}/admins`. Rules: `AddMemberCommandValidator` (ADR-0014). The issuer is
not part of the request: the new administrator signs in through the tenant identity provider, so the API uses the
issuer it trusts for tenant tokens (ADR-0009).

AuditPageResponse.description: One page of an audit log, newest first; `nextCursor` is null on the last page (ADR-0019 keyset paging).

AuditRecordResponse.description: One audit record (SPEC-0009 Contract): codes and ids only, never a name, subject or free text.

CancelOrderRequest.description: Why an order is cancelled: required when the order is paid (it is refunded), ignored otherwise.

CreatePaymentRequest.description:
The body of a payment request: only the provider's payment-method token (for example `sim_success` or
`pm_card_visa`). The amount is the order's; card data is never accepted.

CreatePlanRequest.description: A new plan: its price per string? CreatePlanRequest.Interval (`month` or `year`) and free trial days (0 to 90, default 0).

CreateRefundRequest.description: A refund: the amount, in the payment's currency (a decimal, never a float, AGENTS.md rule 4), and why.

ExportJobResponse.description:
An export job: status `queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or `failed` (with a failure code such as
`too_many_rows`), the rows written, and until when its file downloads.

ImportErrorResponse.description: A row that was not imported: its number (from 1 after the header), the column, and the error code.

ImportErrorsResponse.description: The row errors of an import, by row (the first 1,000).

ImportJobResponse.description:
An import job: status `receiving`, `queued`, `running`, `succeeded` or `failed` (with a failure
code such as `invalid_header` or `too_many_rows`), and what it did so far.

MembershipResponse.description: A membership as the API returns it. The role is its stable name.

MembersResponse.description: The body of `GET /tenants/{tenantId}/members`: a wrapper object, so paging can be added later.

MeResponse.description: Who the caller is: issuer plus subject (ADR-0009).

MoneyResponse.description: An amount of money as the API returns it: a decimal amount and an ISO 4217 currency.

MyMembershipsResponse.description:
The body of `GET /v1/me/memberships`: the caller's own active memberships in active tenants. A wrapper object
rather than a bare array, so a field (paging, say) can be added later without breaking clients.

OpenSupportGrantRequest.description: A support grant request: the tenant, a ticket reference such as `SUP-1234`, and 1 to 240 minutes.

OrderLineRequest.description: One requested line of an order.

OrderLineResponse.description: An order line as the API returns it: the product as it was when the line was set.

OrderResponse.description: An order as the API returns it; its version travels in the `ETag` header, not the body.

PaymentResponse.description: A payment as the API returns it. Status is `processing`, `succeeded`, `failed` or `requires_review`.

PlanListResponse.description: The tenant's active plans, oldest first (at most 100).

PlanResponse.description: A plan as the API returns it.

PriceRequest.description: A price as a client sends it: a decimal amount and an ISO 4217 currency. Never a float (AGENTS.md rule 4).

PriceResponse.description: A price as the API returns it.

ProductPageResponse.description: One page of products; `nextCursor` is null on the last page (ADR-0019 keyset paging).

ProductResponse.description: A product as the API returns it; its version travels in the `ETag` header, not the body.

RefundListResponse.description: The refunds of an order's payment, oldest first.

RefundResponse.description:
A refund as the API returns it, with its audit fields. Status is `processing`, `succeeded`, `failed` or
`requires_review`; kind is `refund` or `cancellation`.

StockResponse.description: A product's stock as the API returns it. `reserved` and `available` were added in SPEC-0004 (additive).

SubscribeRequest.description: Subscribe to a plan, charged with the provider's payment-method token (for example `sim_success`); card data is never accepted.

SubscriptionResponse.description:
A subscription as the API returns it. Status is `trialing`, `incomplete`, `active`, `past_due` or
`cancelled`; the next charge is due at DateTimeOffset SubscriptionResponse.CurrentPeriodEnd unless bool SubscriptionResponse.CancelAtPeriodEnd.

SupportJobResponse.description: An import or export as support sees it: status, counts and failure code, never content.

SupportMemberResponse.description: A membership as support sees it: no issuer or subject (ADR-0027 decision 3).

TenantResponse.description: A tenant as the platform API returns it. Status is a stable lowercase word.

TenantSummaryResponse.description: A tenant as its own members see it: just what they need. Lifecycle details stay on the platform API.

UpdateProductRequest.description: Body of `PUT /tenants/{tenantId}/products/{productId}`. The SKU is not editable.
